name: tauri-plugin-live-activity
description: Tauri 2 plugin for iOS Live Activities (ActivityKit and Dynamic Island) and Android Live Updates with ongoing notification fallback
author: 1eedaegon

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tools && tsc -p tests && tsc -p examples/demo/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/demo/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p examples/demo/tsconfig.live.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api && npm run test:jsx && npm run test:react && npm run test:demo && npm run test:setup
scripts.test:contracts: node --experimental-strip-types --test --experimental-test-coverage "--test-coverage-include=tools/activitykit.ts" "--test-coverage-include=tools/sync-liveupdate.ts" "--test-coverage-include=tools/cargo.ts" --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 tests/contract-files.test.ts tests/typescript-requests.test.ts tests/android-liveupdate.test.ts tests/android-contents.test.ts tests/ci.test.ts tests/ci-cache.test.ts tests/ios-run.test.ts tests/spec-coverage.test.ts tests/docs.test.ts tests/site.test.ts
scripts.test:demo: node --experimental-strip-types --test --experimental-test-coverage "--test-coverage-include=examples/demo/src/*.ts" "--test-coverage-exclude=examples/demo/tests/**" --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 examples/demo/tests/self-test.test.ts examples/demo/tests/ui-state.test.ts examples/demo/tests/layouts.test.ts examples/demo/tests/setup.test.ts examples/demo/tests/live-page.test.ts examples/demo/tests/live-card.test.ts
scripts.write:requests: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-update-snapshots tests/jsx.test.ts tests/react.test.ts examples/demo/tests/layouts.test.ts examples/demo/tests/self-test.test.ts examples/demo/tests/ui-state.test.ts examples/demo/tests/live-card.test.ts
